context: The scene occurs just before Karlach can be recruited: Wyll recognizes her as the assassin target Mizora assigned him. Karlach is scarred and burning, claiming she escaped the Hells and Zariel’s service and begging not to be killed. Wyll is bound by a demonic obligation (and has been presented as a paladin of Tyr), so he’s torn between following Mizora’s orders and believing Karlach — refusing the mission risks severe, supernatural consequences. The player can intervene to avoid or shape this confrontation, and Mizora later returns to judge Wyll (rewarding or damning him) depending on what happens.
